sources.label: Crowe September 2026 USDU reasonable-assurance examination (11 and 30 September 2026 checkpoints; signed 27 October 2026)

reserveReview.rationale: Crowe obtained direct bank confirmations and independently traced Ethereum USDU liabilities to public blockchain records at both examined checkpoints. At 11 September 2026 11:59 PM GST USDU in circulation and reserve assets were both $30,651,543.81; at 30 September 2026 11:59 PM GST both were $30,759,928.73. The Reserve Assets Report states USD 30,759,928.73 held entirely as U.S. dollar deposits, equal to the tested liabilities, with no securities reported. Crowe's ISAE 3000 (Revised) reasonable-assurance conclusion is dated 27 October 2026 and covers the Ethereum contract 0xe4ca6596D2C28014C6f89964F57838e0bE9f369B only; management's notes still permit short-term USD UAE government securities in the future, which Crowe excludes from assurance. The examination does not extend to the subsequently announced Solana integration or to current holdings after the checkpoints.
reserveReview.compositionBasis: Crowe ISAE 3000 reasonable-assurance examination: 30 September 2026 USD deposits of $30,759,928.73 / total reserves of $30,759,928.73 = 100%, matching the exact Ethereum token liabilities at both examined checkpoints; signed 27 October 2026
reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: The examined 30 September 2026 assets are fully classified as USD bank deposits. Management's accompanying notes also permit short-term USD UAE government securities in the future, if and when available; Crowe excludes those notes from assurance, and no securities were reported at either examined checkpoint. Bank-specific shares, contractual deposit maturities and independently established holder insolvency priority are undisclosed.

sources.label: Universal January 29, 2026 launch names reserve banks
Zodia July 2026 USDU custody announcement and reserve-bank claim

custodyProfile.uncertainty: Universal's January 29 launch release and current product page identify Emirates NBD and Mashreq as reserve banks and Mbank separately as a corporate banking partner. Zodia's July custody announcement instead includes Mbank among reserve banks. Crowe names no banks in its examined schedule, so Mbank's reserve role and every bank's allocation remain unresolved. Zodia safeguards clients' USDU tokens, not the underlying reserve deposits or issuer administrative keys. The whitepaper separates Universal reserve accounts from Aquanow client money accounts and describes holder-first pro-rata insolvency distribution. Crowe excludes accompanying notes and legal compliance; these disclosures do not independently verify a holder trust, enforceable insolvency priority or whole-book rehypothecation prohibition. No current reserve-account terms or replacement-custodian recovery arrangement were established.
